containment_policy.inference_authority: descriptor pairs inherited by the launcher only; relayed only for connections whose client socket is held solely by the launcher-started OMP process

observer_boundary.filesystem: explicit Python runtime, observer code, CA bundle and synthetic /etc only; no host HOME, custody, mediator or supervisor state
observer_boundary.network: trusted observer opens only the frozen provider route before accepting subject input, then moves to a private network namespace and installs seccomp denying new sockets, connects and addressed sends
observer_boundary.process: private PID namespace with no host process view; capability set dropped after route setup
observer_boundary.provider_route_capability: one connected stream socket owned by the observer; inference requests remain single-purpose and evidence is append-only

containment_policy.subject_boundary: bubblewrap user/pid/ipc/uts/cgroup/net namespaces, empty network namespace (loopback only), all capabilities dropped, seccomp denies AF_UNIX sockets and process inspection, explicit digest-bound runtime dependency manifest plus synthetic /etc, candidate bundle mounted read-only, no host HOME/custody/private state

credential_service_account_policy.parent_authentication: one qualification-only provider credential held only by the provider-control/observation principal
